1. a chlorobenzene ring – SMILES: Clc1ccc(cc1)
2. an aromatic ester fragment containing the carbonyl, an ether oxygen, a phenyl ring and a methoxy group – SMILES: C(=O)Oc2ccccc2OC

These SMILES represent the fragments that, when connected, give a molecule matching the provided data.</thought>
